verification.scope: Source blobs and commit/tree path traversal; run/attempt/repository/job/head comparisons; selected artifact metadata run/head bindings; status/decision candidate-head bindings; canonical projection digests.
verification.source_reference_rule: Resolve sources by exact commit/path and verify bytes, SHA-256 and canonical Git blob SHA-1 before using a json_pointer. @json-fence-N selects the zero-based JSON fenced block inside the preceding string. A {ref:{source_id,json_pointer}} is the existing value, never a copied assertion.
verification.canonical_projection_hash: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, finite numbers, excluding projection_sha256 itself. The surrounding Git commit binds sources and these hashes.
verification.workflow_binding_limit: The blob_at_run_head binds a durable definition in that tree. It does not attest an alternative trusted-default-branch checkout or reusable workflow execution source.
verification.attempt_binding_limit: Only source-specified attempts are historical subject bindings. An unspecified attempt snapshots the latest native attempt at read; it does not replace an earlier job or transfer its result.
verification.artifact_digest_limit: Provider artifact digests and run/head association are recorded. Artifact API does not expose attempt; payloads were not downloaded and no raw content claim is added.
verification.retention_configuration: Public maximum 90 days confirmed in the GitHub 2026-10-01 primary-source changelog; actual repository retention days not read, no expiration date invented.
verification.bootstrap: Tool cache 14/14; read-only boot CONTINUE after existing stale Main integrity projections were regenerated in this candidate; optional tools not installed.
verification.claim_binding_limits: Run/Attempt/Head/Tree/Workflow/Job are independently compared with native metadata. A source reference locates a historical claim; candidate subject heads and temporary PR merge execution heads can differ. The snapshot does not silently treat a source head hint or a green observer conclusion as proof of that candidate or of governance admission.
verification.source_availability_limit: Reference values reuse repository Git objects and require their retained carrier commits. This does not archive every historical checkout, workflow source or referenced log/artifact payload, and is not an offline full-repository or provider-signed execution receipt.
